major_cooldowns.name: Evangelism
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Start your ramp 8 seconds before the damage lands and chain the two instant Power Word: Radiance casts it grants.

major_cooldowns.name: Ultimate Penitence
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Save it for a heavy damage window away from Evangelism, leading with Mind Blast as Voidweaver and spell queuing Void Shield just before the cast ends.

major_cooldowns.name: Mindbender
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it while your Atonements are out so its damage converts into healing.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Two live Mindbender ids share the name: 123040 (12s tooltip, the Discipline pet) and 200174 (10s). Neither was cast in the sampled parses and the guide never names the pet; Shadowfiend appears only as self aura 1280172 with no cast id in the table.

rule.description: Keep Shadow Word: Pain on your enemies
rule.action: Refresh Shadow Word: Pain as it nears expiry and spread it with offensive Penance.

rule.description: Bank Power Word: Radiance charges for Evangelism
rule.action: Spend spare charges on mini-ramps but keep two banked as Evangelism comes up.

rule.description: Shadow Word: Death replaces Smite in execute
rule.action: Swap your Smite filler to Shadow Word: Death once the target is in execute.

rule.description: Power Word: Shield at high Weal and Woe stacks
rule.action: Let Weal and Woe stack up before you shield, and cut shield casts when mana is low.
